tema: Past Continuous vs Past Simple — Interrupted!

cast_dialogue.linea: Life is a long movie, heroes, and interruptions are the plot twists. 'While' runs the movie; 'when' fires the twist.
I was taking a shower when the phone rang. Of course!
While I was studying, my sister was playing loud music. Impossible to concentrate!
I was walking in the park when it started to rain. I got completely wet.
I was cooking dinner when the lights went out. We ate by candlelight — it was romantic!

banco_oraciones.oracion: I was taking a shower when the phone rang.
While I was studying, my sister was playing music.
She was walking in the park when it started to rain.
They were sleeping when the alarm went off.
I wasn't sleeping when you called.
She wasn't watching TV when the lights went out.
We weren't driving when the accident happened.
What were you doing when I called?
Were you sleeping when the alarm went off?
What was she doing at eight o'clock?
Were you studying? Yes, I was.
Was it raining? No, it wasn't.
Were they watching TV? Yes, they were.

banner_diagnostico.opcion_a: I took a shower when the phone was ringing.
banner_diagnostico.opcion_b: I was taking a shower when the phone rang.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: The past continuous (was/were + -ing) is the long background action; the past simple is the short interruption. 'While' + long action, 'when' + short action.

filas: While I was cooking, he was reading.
I was cooking when he arrived.

ejercicios.pregunta: I ___ a shower when the phone rang.
They were sleeping when the alarm ___.

ejercicios.afirmacion: 'While' usually goes with the past continuous.
The short interruption uses the past continuous.

ejercicios.texto: She ___ in the park when it started to rain. (walk)

ejercicios.respuesta: She was cooking when the lights went out.

ejercicios.texto_con_error: I watched TV when the lights were going out.
ejercicios.respuesta: I was watching TV when the lights went out.

ejercicios.oracion_base: I was sleeping when you called.
ejercicios.respuesta: I wasn't sleeping when you called.

ejercicios.instruccion: Turn it into a question with 'what'.
ejercicios.respuesta: What were you doing at eight?

ejercicios.pregunta: What were you doing yesterday at nine in the evening? (Full sentence.)

guion: Sofía: You look tired, Ben. What happened?
Ben: I was sleeping when the neighbor's dog barked at 3 a.m.!
Ben: I couldn't sleep again. While I was trying to sleep, my phone rang.
Ben: Nobody! A wrong number. What a night!

reading.texto: Last night was full of interruptions. Ben was sleeping when the neighbor's dog barked at 3 a.m. While he was trying to sleep again, his phone rang — a wrong number! Sofía was walking home when it started to rain, and she got completely wet. Abuela Carmen was cooking dinner when the lights went out, so they ate by candlelight. Sometimes, interruptions make the best stories.

preguntas.afirmacion: Sofía was driving when it started to rain.

partes.parte: B — Completa con while o when

ejercicios.texto: ___ I was cooking, he was reading.
She was walking ___ it started to rain.
Corrige: 'I watched TV when the lights were going out.'
Corrige: 'While I studied, my sister was playing music.'
Escribe 3 oraciones sobre interrupciones de tu vida con when/while.

answer_key: 8. I was watching TV when the lights went out.
9. While I was studying, my sister was playing music.
10. Respuesta libre (ej. 'I was sleeping when the alarm went off. While I was cooking, my friend arrived.')
